decisions.F027: Zhelvek retains energy bar and gains energy carrier; no replacement food headword.
decisions.F025: Use Shalor alone in the sanctuary example. Preserve separately approved participant sense of -in alongside plural use.
decisions.F053: -al remains universal continuous suffix. Varan is a specialized locative-stative form from Var + an, expressing residing, staying, or being located; -an is not a continuous suffix.
decisions.F084: Noral: /nohr-ahl/, Noun, Night / nighttime / nocturnal hours; Nor time + -al continuous/duration. Preserve night translations.
decisions.F091: Accept recommended city correction: Nor-var I an Varthas; I will go to the city.
decisions.F038: Retain explicit family phrases in the two ritual corrections; preserve already-applied F048 grain/storm corrections.
decisions.F024: Accept home/canvas translation instead of inventing a tent sense; use Emil for meal examples.
decisions.F005/F032: Lianeth has Modal, Adjective, and a separate Verb label, preserving the approved ability and reliability senses.
decisions.F052–F087: Settle word definitions separately; verify derivations against the app and leave unsupported derivations pending.

numbering_interpretation: After the Noral table, final agreements numbered 5–9 correspond in sequence to city sentence, ritual family phrases, tent/home, Lianeth labels (with explicit separate Verb), and derivations.

possession.new_spacing_rule: Standalone ka exclusively without/no. Possessive -ka must attach to possessor with a hyphen.
possession.new_suffix_rule: Direct personal body parts, inner states, primary gear/personal clothes mandate possessed-noun suffixes: -ian my, -ya your, -eshen their.
possession.collective_rule: Use possessor-ka for collective, third-person, or multi-word ownership; examples include Ilin-ka emil, Varthas-ka vorkor, Seren-ka arthkal.
possession.later_conflicting_text: Later correction proposes La ka kelvor, despite floating-ka ban, or kelvor-esh, despite mandated -eshen for their body parts.
possession.recommended_resolution: Superseded by explicit La-ka kelvor clarification.
possession.final_user_clarification: Use La-ka kelvor; user explicitly confirmed the third-person body-part allowance.
